CustomField.formula:
TEXT(MONTH(DATEVALUE(SchedStartTime + CASE(TEXT(TimeZone), "America/Kentucky/Louisville",-5/24, "America/Indiana/Indianapolis",-5/24, "(GMT-06:00) Central Standard Time (America/Chicago)",-6/24, "(GMT-07:00) Mountain Standard Time (America/Denver)",-7/24, "America/Vancouver",-8/24, "(GMT-08:00) Pacific Standard Time (America/Los_Angeles)",-8/24, -5/24)))) & "/" &
TEXT(DAY(DATEVALUE(SchedStartTime + CASE(TEXT(TimeZone), "America/Kentucky/Louisville",-5/24, "America/Indiana/Indianapolis",-5/24, "(GMT-06:00) Central Standard Time (America/Chicago)",-6/24, "(GMT-07:00) Mountain Standard Time (America/Denver)",-7/24, "America/Vancouver",-8/24, "(GMT-08:00) Pacific Standard Time (America/Los_Angeles)",-8/24, -5/24)))) & "/" &
TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(SchedStartTime + CASE(TEXT(TimeZone), "America/Kentucky/Louisville",-5/24, "America/Indiana/Indianapolis",-5/24, "(GMT-06:00) Central Standard Time (America/Chicago)",-6/24, "(GMT-07:00) Mountain Standard Time (America/Denver)",-7/24, "America/Vancouver",-8/24, "(GMT-08:00) Pacific Standard Time (America/Los_Angeles)",-8/24, -5/24)))) & " " &
IF(OR( VALUE(MID(TEXT(SchedStartTime + CASE(TEXT(TimeZone), "America/Kentucky/Louisville",-5/24, "America/Indiana/Indianapolis",-5/24, "(GMT-06:00) Central Standard Time (America/Chicago)",-6/24, "(GMT-07:00) Mountain Standard Time (America/Denver)",-7/24, "America/Vancouver",-8/24, "(GMT-08:00) Pacific Standard Time (America/Los_Angeles)",-8/24, -5/24)), 12, 2)) = 0, VALUE(MID(TEXT(SchedStartTime + CASE(TEXT(TimeZone), "America/Kentucky/Louisville",-5/24, "America/Indiana/Indianapolis",-5/24, "(GMT-06:00) Central Standard Time (America/Chicago)",-6/24, "(GMT-07:00) Mountain Standard Time (America/Denver)",-7/24, "America/Vancouver",-8/24, "(GMT-08:00) Pacific Standard Time (America/Los_Angeles)",-8/24, -5/24)), 12, 2)) = 12 ), "12",
TEXT(VALUE(MID(TEXT(SchedStartTime + CASE(TEXT(TimeZone), "America/Kentucky/Louisville",-5/24, "America/Indiana/Indianapolis",-5/24, "(GMT-06:00) Central Standard Time (America/Chicago)",-6/24, "(GMT-07:00) Mountain Standard Time (America/Denver)",-7/24, "America/Vancouver",-8/24, "(GMT-08:00) Pacific Standard Time (America/Los_Angeles)",-8/24, -5/24)), 12, 2)) - IF(VALUE(MID(TEXT(SchedStartTime + CASE(TEXT(TimeZone), "America/Kentucky/Louisville",-5/24, "America/Indiana/Indianapolis",-5/24, "(GMT-06:00) Central Standard Time (America/Chicago)",-6/24, "(GMT-07:00) Mountain Standard Time (America/Denver)",-7/24, "America/Vancouver",-8/24, "(GMT-08:00) Pacific Standard Time (America/Los_Angeles)",-8/24, -5/24)), 12, 2)) > 12, 12, 0)) )
& ":" & MID(TEXT(SchedStartTime), 15, 2) &
IF(VALUE(MID(TEXT(SchedStartTime + CASE(TEXT(TimeZone), "America/Kentucky/Louisville",-5/24, "America/Indiana/Indianapolis",-5/24, "(GMT-06:00) Central Standard Time (America/Chicago)",-6/24, "(GMT-07:00) Mountain Standard Time (America/Denver)",-7/24, "America/Vancouver",-8/24, "(GMT-08:00) Pacific Standard Time (America/Los_Angeles)",-8/24, -5/24)), 12, 2)) >= 12, "PM", "AM")
& " " &
CASE(TEXT(TimeZone), "(GMT-06:00) Central Standard Time (America/Chicago)", "CST", "(GMT-07:00) Mountain Standard Time (America/Denver)", "MST", "America/Vancouver", "PST", "(GMT-08:00) Pacific Standard Time (America/Los_Angeles)", "PST", "America/Kentucky/Louisville", "EST", "America/Indiana/Indianapolis", "EST", "EST" )
